name: Harmonics
author: Emilie Gillet
description: Braids' twelve-partial additive stack, with two Lorentzian bumps sliding over the harmonic series. Its integer amplitude slew gates quiet partials out entirely, which is the grain the Plaits harmonic engine's float smoothing does not have.

controls.label: Colour
controls.description: Braids' COLOR, welded as the module has it: the bumps narrow toward both ends while the second one grows.

controls.label: Peak
controls.description: Slides the first bump from the fundamental to the twelfth partial; the second follows at half that index plus six.

controls.label: Spread
controls.description: Moves the second bump off the module's fixed relation, six partials either way. Centre is Braids.

controls.label: Width
controls.description: Scales the bump width around whatever Colour chose, so the two stop sharing a knob. Noon is Braids.

outputs.main: Mono: the twelve-partial stack at Peak. Stereo: the same stack with a small leftward Peak offset.
outputs.aux: Mono: the stack with Peak reflected. Stereo: the same stack with a small rightward Peak offset.

trigger: Realigns the shared partial phase so each triggered note starts alike.
